profile_text.body:
Rackspace Technology is a public company traded under the ticker RXT, and its site describes it as a cloud computing services pioneer that delivers multicloud solutions across applications, data, and security. The company says it has helped customers move from hosting to cloud to enterprise AI, positioning itself as an operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. It reports assembling partners across layers of that stack to connect models, platform, and infrastructure into a governed system aimed at regulated environments.

Its AI offering is presented as part of an Enterprise AI Cloud, which the company describes as a secure, regulated, and compliant foundation built on AI-optimized hardware. Rackspace says its engineers embed directly in customer environments to build, deploy, and operate AI workloads in production, and that it remains accountable for outcomes after deployment. Security, compliance, data sovereignty, and uptime are described as foundational to the enterprise AI clouds it operates. The site cites customers in financial services, healthcare, and government, and includes a quote from Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer at Seattle Children's Hospital.

Beyond the company profile, the record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for Rackspace. Its SEC central index key is 0001810019.
